probes.notes: T3 primary: a Collection of two full-content udtVchSeriesGrpConfig rows (htype 50333725) passed as p_CodeCol; p_SeriesName guessed as a 1-item Collection. Acceptance = envelope ok:true (callee executed, any business result incl. invisible validation raise); unsupported_arg_type / BadArgs = bridge regression. Rows reuse the iter22 full-content shape that SaveVchSeriesGrpConfig accepted (ok:true).

arg-shape variant: p_SeriesName as a plain VT_BSTR (single-name reading of the param name). Either this or t3-multiseries-record-rows must execute for acceptance; record which p_SeriesName shape BUSY takes.

discovery/control: if the scalar-code collection executes but the record rows fail with a TYPE error at the callee (not unsupported_arg_type), p_CodeCol wants plain codes and the UDT-row reading belongs to a different param - evidence, not a failure of T3 marshaling.
regression control (iter22 series-grp-write-full, proven ok:true with no observable persistence): scalar $collection-inside-$record path must stay unchanged after T3.
